caption: The drawing features a circular composition enclosed by a double border, with a line of German text written in brown around the inner circumference. Inside the circle, there is a central figure riding a horse that is rendered in brown with a black mane and tail. The rider, who has pale skin and a neutral expression, is dressed in a green outfit with red details, white trousers, and a hat. The horse is shown in profile, galloping toward the left side of the circle. The background within the circle is filled with stylized floral elements, including two large, multi-colored flowers flanking the rider (one primarily green and blue with red, and the other mostly brown, blue, and white), as well as green and blue leafy shapes at the bottom and sides. The overall color scheme includes brown, green, blue, red, and white on a cream-colored paper background.
title: Pa. German Plate
